application_conditions: Sign-up button → https://affiliates.redotpay.com/login (own portal); the page says you apply through the RedotPay app or website, complete identity verification, then are approved. Fields not listed publicly. Levels LV1 (0–9 referrals), LV2 (10–29), LV3 (30+), Exclusive for KOLs/affiliates who cooperate directly (2026-11-04 re-read; blog 2024-12-23).
paid_action: Card application (instant commission), card activation (one-time), referred users' transactions (monthly, settled after 30 days), Tier-2 10% of referral's commission for 365 days.
validation_conditions: Transaction commissions settled after 30 days. Rates per level shown as an image on the blog (unreadable).

commission.model_note: 'Up to 40% commission' headline; card activation and application commissions amounts not published in text; transaction commission % not published.

revenue_share.duration_note: Tier-2 for 365 days; direct duration not stated

payout.frequency: application commissions instant; transaction earnings monthly

rules_note: Marketing kit (banners, email templates, social posts). No region or channel restrictions published; 47 non-issuance regions apply to users.

evidence.title: RedotPay Affiliate Program (blog, 2024-12-23)
evidence.excerpt: Card-activation commission (one-time, immediate), transaction commission ('typically settled after 30 days'), Tier-2 commission 10% of a referral's commission; levels Exclusive / LV1 0–9 / LV2 10–29 / LV3 30+; rates only in an image.

notes: Strongest card-order-based programme found so far: pays on card application/activation, not only on trading. Rates unknown until inside the dashboard.
